messages.subject: Reactive Boxplot- Presidential Candidate data
parts:
Hi there,

I'm in desperate need of help. I started an internship about 6 weeks ago and was given an assignment to create a shiny app to visualize some data. As an economics major I have done a lot of data analysis using stata, spss and excel but I never used r or anything really like it. So for the past 6 weeks I have been going through a bunch of tutorials but I still can't get the app that I want. My boss doesn't know any R so I don't have any real guidance on things I may be overlooking. 

So I have a data set that shows all the presidential candidates fundraising contributions (see attached). What I've been trying to do is create an interactive output that gives a box plot to each candidate you check, which would show and compare the distribution of their contributions. 
I think my main struggles are coming from my server.r. Let me know if what I'm trying to do is impossible. If anybody has any suggestions or already made examples of what I'm trying to do, I would be forever grateful!

Thank you!
